newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs firm but capped near 124.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs firm but capped near 124.00.

text.p: Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are expected to be strong following a rebound in London on short-covering, with additional upward energy likely to come from sharp gains in U.S. Treasury bonds overnight.

But the topside is expected to be capped near 124.00 amid a likely absence of institutional investors, who are wary of active buying ahead of the release of the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) "tankan" survey of corporate sentiment on June 25.
Possible gains in Tokyo stocks after Dow industrials' fifth straight record finish on Thursday will also keep the topside heavy and operators cautious, traders said.
